name: Microsoft Teams — Application Installed
description:
Attacker objective
Deliver a malicious application into the collaboration platform — a Teams app can request permissions, phish users, or exfiltrate messages and files.

Attack logic
Attackers publish or side-load a malicious Teams app to gain a foothold in the collaboration environment. A newly-seen app being installed warrants review of its publisher and permissions.

Why this detection works
The unified audit log records Teams app installations; a new-terms model over the app identity surfaces first-seen applications while suppressing the routine re-installation of already-known apps.

False positives
Onboarding of a legitimate, sanctioned Teams application.

Tuning
Allowlist approved apps; review the publisher and requested permissions of any new app.

Required telemetry
o365.audit RecordType 25 / MicrosoftTeams, Operation 'AppInstalled' (AddOnName/app identity, user.name).
author: raadabujaish
note:
## Investigation guide
1. Identify the installed application and its publisher; confirm it is sanctioned.
2. If untrusted, remove the app and review what it accessed and which users it reached.
false_positives: Onboarding of a legitimate, sanctioned Teams application.
